tier: scope-(a) correction to the INTERPRETATION of the C_knot spread; no closure, no exclusion, no fit

result.object: S(K) = Σ_λ t_λ,  t_λ = y_λ·χ^λ(β_K)·(−1)^{n(λ)}·f^λ  — the master binding sum; C_knot(K) = B_AME(K)/(m_e·|S(K)|)
result.cancellation_ratio_def: κ(K) = |S(K)| / Σ_λ|t_λ(K)| ∈ [0,1]. Reciprocal condition number: ‖δ‖_∞ ≤ ε ⇒ |S′−S| ≤ ε·Σ|t| = (ε/κ)|S|. ε = κ drives S to 0, i.e. C_knot to +∞.
result.delta_min_def: δ_min^∞(K) = |B_AME/m_e − S| / Σ_λ|t_λ| — the MINIMUM sup-norm relative per-block correction {δ_λ} with Σ t_λ(1+δ_λ) = target. A LOWER BOUND on the missing per-block structure, not the structure; equal δ_min does NOT mean equal correction direction.

corroboration.threerow_4he_sign_change_in_q: threerow_4he_completion_probe.py (bean qou-prjo) records 4He_sign_at_qlo=+1, 4He_sign_at_q0=−1 for the ℓ(λ)≥3 stratum of the same object — a sign change, hence a zero, hence κ=0 somewhere on the physical interval. The small κ measured here at q₀ is the full-sum shadow of that crossing. Independent producer, not re-run here.
corroboration.convention_migration_amplification: Historical: under 70d1ade383 (convention C→D) |S| moved 3.5%/34%/33%/96.8% for D/T/³He/⁴He (5.9456 → 0.19094 for ⁴He). A ~24% per-term perturbation amplified by 1/κ≈126 reproduces the 96.8% move; no ⁴He-specific mechanism is required.

what_this_does_not_claim: NOT a claim that C_knot is universal — it is not; the per-knot non-universality of c_knot_nonuniversal_pinned_weight_probe.py stands.
NOT a weakening of the Lean mirror-pair exclusion CKnotNonUniversal.no_level_only_closure: T and ³He are both well-conditioned here (κ ≈ 0.294–0.414), so that exclusion is untouched.
NOT a new ansatz for the Δ_λ magnitude. κ and δ_min are diagnostics of the EXISTING formula. No per-block weight is proposed (AGENTS.md: no seventh fit-based ansatz).
δ_min is a LOWER BOUND on the correction size, not a derived Δ_λ, and is not wired.
result.verdict: The headline C_knot spread (59.1193×) is dominated by one ill-conditioned denominator: κ(⁴He) = 0.007955 (1/κ = 125.71×), with its largest single block term 52.05× the whole signed sum. Re-expressed per block, the same information gives spread 2.0535× with every isotope needing an order-unity relative correction. The Δ_λ magnitude remains OPEN (qou-3q7t).
result.anti_fit: B_AME enters only through the diagnostic ratios C_knot and δ_min, never inverted into a canonical weight (owner directive: Δ_λ from inverted CODATA = NOT ALLOWED). y_λ recomputed from the Wenzl closed form (Σ y_λ f^λ = 1 asserted); χ^λ from the committed interface-inclusive Rust caches; free_parameters = 0; nothing wired.
